tools.description: Full detail for one artwork: attribution, medium, dimensions, edition structure, provenance, seller, and every individual impression that can be bought with its own price and availability. tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Re-check whether specific impressions are still purchasable, immediately before presenting them to a buyer or attempting a purchase. Each work here is unique or from a small edition, so an impression can sell between search and checkout. ALWAYS call this before offering a specific impression — offer

tools.name: start_purchase
tools.description: Begin buying ONE impression. An impression is a single physical object — a unique painting, or one numbered print of an edition — so exactly one listing_id is accepted; to buy several works, start a separate purchase for each, because each is sold by its own seller and is a separate payment to Fold.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Read the current state of a purchase you started. Totals and availability reflect this moment, not when it was started — a work can sell to another buyer while yours is deciding.

tools.name: set_delivery
tools.description: Supply the delivery address, which is what makes a total payable. Sales tax depends on where the work is going and is recalculated on every call, so the total can change here. tools.name: confirm_purchase
tools.description: Charge for the work. Calling this ASSERTS that the buyer has seen the full total — work, delivery and tax — and approved it; that approval is recorded as the consent record for this sale, so do not call it speculatively or to "check" anything. tools.name: cancel_purchase
tools.description: Abandon a purchase and release any hold on the work, so another collector can buy it. A purchase already being paid for cannot be cancelled: it will complete, or be resolved by a person at Fold, so read it again later; a completed one cannot be cancelled either, and needs a refund instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_artwork · Private data: start_purchase, confirm_purchase · Public sink: start_purchase · Destructive: get_artwork.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_artwork · Private data: start_purchase, confirm_purchase · Public sink: start_purchase · Destructive: get_artwork

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
